# Mutual Drug

> > Mutual Drug is a cooperative pharmacy wholesaler serving independent pharmacies across the Southeast through group purchasing, product distribution, and comprehensive member support services.

Mutual Drug operates as a membership-based cooperative network providing wholesale pharmaceutical distribution, buying group services through OptiSource, and advocacy support for independent pharmacies in North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, and Georgia. The organization combines product distribution capabilities with business support, marketing assistance, and legislative advocacy to help independent pharmacy members compete and thrive.
